name: Zimbabwe
dated: Finance Act 2025 (No. 7 of 2025) s. 34 (quotes the 2025 wording of the VAT general rate); Finance Acts 2023, 2024, 2024 (No. 2)
sources: No usable 2025 text for these headings: Finance Acts 2024 and Veritas pages are held; the Income Tax Act rates (Charging Schedule) and the VAT Act were not resolved in this pass. Second pass: Finance Act 2025 (No. 7 of 2025) s. 34 (quotes the 2025 wording of the VAT general rate); Finance Acts 2023, 2024, 2024 (No. 2). Finance Act [Chapter 23:04], Income Tax Act [Chapter 23:06] and VAT Act [Chapter 23:12] as updated by ZIMRA to 1 December 2024 (incorporating the Finance (No. 2) Act 7 of 2024 amendments from 1 January 2025), from zimra.co.zw/legislation/17-acts (`cmp20/global/R4/fetch/zw8/`, SHA256SUMS).

vat.name: Value Added Tax
vat.statute: Finance Act [Chapter 23:04] Chapter IV Schedule Part I ('fifteen per centum'), as shown by Finance Act 2025 s. 34 (15,5 % only from 1 Jan 2026)
vat.doc: Finance Act 2025 s. 34: "With effect from the 1st January, 2026, the Schedule to Chapter IV of the Finance Act [Chapter 23:04] is amended in Part I ('General Rate of Value Added Tax') by the deletion of 'fifteen per centum' and the substitution of 'fifteen comma five per centum'." So the general rate in force throughout 2025 was 15 %. The Schedule itself was not read (grade B); zero-rated and exempt supplies not applied.
notes: VAT 15 % in 2025 (Finance Act 2025 s. 34 raises it to 15,5 % from 1 Jan 2026); zero-rated basic foods not separable
unsupported: zero-rated and exempt supplies (VAT Act Schedules) not applied

excise.name: Excises

cit.name: Corporate income tax
cit.statute: Finance Act [Chapter 23:04] s. 14 (2) (c) and Schedule to Chapter I Part II (taxable income of a company or trust 25 %), ZIMRA consolidation to 1 December 2024 incl. the Finance (No. 2) Act 2024 changes from 1 January 2025; the Finance Act 2025 does not amend s. 14 (2) (c)
cit.doc: Finance Act s. 14 (2): "the income tax with which a person is chargeable in the year of assessment beginning on the 1st January, 2012 or any subsequent year of assessment shall be calculated ... (c) in the case of a company or a trust ... at the specified percentage"; Schedule to Chapter I, Part II (Current rates of income tax on taxable income, "Substituted by the FINANCE ACT -/2024"): "14(2)(c) Taxable income of company or trust 25" (the same 25 % in the 2024 table; 24 % appears only in the tables substituted by Act 10/2020). ZIMRA's corporate 'Tax rates' page: "Income of company or trust 14(2c) 25% ... Aids Levy: Rate is based on tax chargeable 3%".
notes: the AIDS levy (3 % of the income tax chargeable, imposed outside the Finance Act) is not modelled: the effective rate would be 25,75 %
licensed investors, mining, BOOT/BOT, special economic zones and export-manufacturing rates (s. 14 (2) (e)-(j), 14 (3)) are not modelled

wht.name: Non-residents' taxes
wht.statute: Finance Act [Chapter 23:04] s. 15 (c) (non-resident shareholders' tax 15 % on unlisted dividends), s. 19 (non-residents' tax on fees 15 %, substituted from 1 January 2025), s. 21 (non-residents' tax on royalties 15 %), ZIMRA consolidation to 1 December 2024; twelfth pass: Income Tax Act [Chapter 23:06] s. 29 (non-residents' tax on interest) repealed by Act 5/2009 w.e.f. 30 September 2009: no withholding on interest paid to non-residents
wht.doc: s. 15: "The non-resident shareholders' tax ... shall be calculated (a) ... listed ... at the rate of 10%; (b) ... Victoria Falls Stock Exchange ... 5%; (c) in the case of any other dividend, at the rate of 15%"; s. 19 ("repealed and substituted by Act -/2024 w.e.f. 1st January, 2025"): "The non-residents' tax on fees ... shall be calculated at the rate of 15% of each dollar of the fees" (10 % for licensed investors); s. 21: "The non-residents' tax on royalties ... shall be calculated at the rate of 15% of each dollar of the royalty". Twelfth pass (kernel 2.3.0 grade-C withholding): interest 0 %: Income Tax Act [Chapter 23:06] s. 29 (non-residents' tax on interest) repealed by Act 5/2009 w.e.f. 30 September 2009: no withholding on interest paid to non-residents

rules.statute: Income Tax Act [Chapter 23:06] s. 29 (non-residents' tax on interest) repealed by Act 5/2009 w.e.f. 30 September 2009: no withholding on interest paid to non-residents

notes: listed dividends are at 10 % (5 % on the Victoria Falls Stock Exchange): the company's dividend is taken as unlisted; interest paid to non-residents bears no non-residents' tax (not modelled as a charge)
non-residents' tax on remittances (15 %, s. 20) on branch remittances not modelled
